Class GainPP

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.effects.instant.CardEffectInstant
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.effects.instant.GainPP
public class GainPP extends CardEffectInstant
An instant effect that grants prestige points to the owning player.

The exact gain rule is determined by gainPpType: it may award a flat amount, an amount based on the number of cards of a given category in the village, double the builder points, or activate the double shaman income bonus. The ppAmount and cat fields carry the parameters used by the chosen rule.
